# Termux-Diffusion (v1.6.8)
> Pure CPU Native On-Device Stable Diffusion Runtime for Android Termux

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-diffusion
- Installation: `pip install termux-diffusion && termux-diffusion install
# or:
npm install termux-diffusion && npx termux-diffusion install`
- Architecture: Executes quantized Stable Diffusion models with ARMv8.2-A DotProd/FP16 NEON SIMD vector instructions, VAE tiling, and direct Android MediaStore synchronization.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import termux_diffusion as td

# 1. Generate image using pure CPU on Android hardware
image_path = td.generate(
    prompt="cute dolphin, high quality illustration",
    model="anime",
    steps=6,
    device="cpu"
)
print(f"Generated and saved to Gallery: {image_path}")

```
